programs.source: function encode64(source) alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/" bytes = codeunits(source) output = IOBuffer() for first = 1:3:length(bytes) remaining = min(3, length(bytes)-first+1) value = 0 for offset = 0:2 value = value*256+(offset < remaining ? Int(bytes[first+offset]) : 0) end for (offset, divisor) in enumerate([262144, 4096, 64, 1]) print(output, offset <= remaining+1 ? alphabet[div(value, divisor)%64+1] : '=') end end return String(take!(output)) for source in ["Man", "Hello, World!", "", "bold", "a+b=c?"] encoded = encode64(source) println('"', source, "\" -> \"", encoded, '"') end
